mapper.select: SELECT student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, account.total_points, account.available_points, account.updated_at FROM growth_point_account account JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = account.student_id WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.sql: SELECT ledger.id, ledger.change_type, ledger.amount, ledger.available_delta, ledger.source_assignment_id, ledger.source_exchange_id, ledger.source_task_id, ledger.base_points_snapshot, ledger.decay_percent, ledger.streak_days, ledger.decay_rule_id, ledger.source_type, ledger.source_organization_id, organization.organization_name AS source_organization_name, task.title AS task_title, ledger.reviewer_user_id, reviewer.display_name AS reviewer_display_name, ledger.occurred_at, ledger.remark, ledger.correction_of_id, correction.id AS correction_ledger_id, assignment.current_status AS assignment_status, assignment.current_reviewer_id AS assignment_reviewer_user_id FROM growth_point_ledger ledger LEFT JOIN learn_task_assignment assignment ON assignment.id = ledger.source_assignment_id LEFT JOIN learn_task task ON task.id = assignment.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_organization organization ON organization.id = ledger.source_organization_id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = ledger.reviewer_user_id LEFT JOIN growth_point_ledger correction ON correction.correction_of_id = ledger.id AND correction.change_type = 'CORRECTION'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM growth_point_ledger WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT student.id AS student_id, student.student_name FROM edu_parent_student parent_student JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = parent_student.student_id WHERE parent_student.parent_user_id = #{parentUserId} AND parent_student.status = 'ACTIVE' AND parent_student.relation_role = 'PRIMARY_GUARDIAN' AND parent_student.primary_scope_key = 'PRIMARY' AND student.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY student.created_at, student.id
